key-vault-hsm-pool-soft-delete.title: A deleted Managed HSM pool keeps billing until it is purged
key-vault-hsm-pool-soft-delete.body: This estimate includes a Managed HSM pool. Microsoft states that a soft-deleted Managed HSM keeps billing at its full hourly rate until it is purged, so plan to purge pools you no longer need, or budget for the retention period.

citation.quote: Soft-deleted Managed HSM resources will continue to be billed at their full hourly rate until they're purged.

key-vault-rotation-key-versions.title: Key rotation adds HSM key versions
key-vault-rotation-key-versions.body: This estimate rotates HSM-protected keys. Each rotation creates a new key version, and Microsoft bills each version of an HSM-protected key as a separate key, so the HSM key count should include the versions created by rotation.

citation.quote: each version of an HSM protected key is counted as a separate key

more.source: Configure cryptographic key auto-rotation in Azure Key Vault
more.quote: Key rotation generates a new key version of an existing key with new key material.

key-vault-cache-secrets.title: Cache secrets to reduce Key Vault operations
key-vault-cache-secrets.body: This estimate has a high number of Key Vault operations. Microsoft recommends caching retrieved secrets in memory and reusing them, which lowers the operations charge and the risk of throttling.

citation.quote: Cache the secrets you retrieve from Azure Key Vault in memory, and reuse from memory whenever possible.
